01 Home Services.title: How home services work
steps: Taskora assigns the best verified professional
req: Verified badge before the first job
01 Home Services.safety: Warranty on service and parts where applicable. Emergency and same-hour jobs can carry a surcharge (up to +50%), always shown before you confirm.

02 Cleaning & Laundry.title: How cleaning works
steps: Professional confirms and arrives with equipment
02 Cleaning & Laundry.safety: Rework or refund if the job does not meet the checklist.

03 Construction & Renovation.title: How construction projects work
req: Licensed contractors; PEC-registered civil, electrical and mechanical engineers
03 Construction & Renovation.safety: Payments are released by milestone. Construction starts only after the building plan is approved by the relevant authority.

04 Architects & Interior Design.title: How architecture projects work
req: Knowledge of building codes and bylaws
04 Architects & Interior Design.safety: Drawings submitted for approval are signed only by PCATP-registered architects or PEC-registered engineers. Government approval fees are paid directly to the authority.

06 Chartered Accountants & Taxation.title: How CA services work
req: ICAP member (or ICMAP / PIPFA for relevant services)
Valid practice licence for audit work
06 Chartered Accountants & Taxation.safety: Statutory audits are signed only by ICAP practising firms. Share documents through the secure upload, not WhatsApp.

07 Corporate Contracts.title: Contract lifecycle we manage
req: Bar-licensed advocates for legal review and advice
07 Corporate Contracts.safety: Legal advice is given only by Bar-licensed advocates. Stamp duty and registration fees are paid to the government separately.

08 Housing Society Services.title: Society management, A to Z
req: Licensed advocates for legal work; qualified accountants for finance
Society contracts run on a signed agreement with the management committee

extra.title: Society contract management: tender to renewal

08 Housing Society Services.safety: Allotment, transfer and NOC records remain the society's property. All collections go to the society's own bank account.

16 Beauty & Wellness.title: How beauty and wellness bookings work
16 Beauty & Wellness.safety: Women customers are served by women professionals, and massage uses same-gender therapists only. Laser and medical skin treatments are offered only through licensed clinics.

15 Healthcare Services.title: How healthcare bookings work
steps: Service delivered with care and safety
req: Valid licence and registration (PMDC, PNMC or relevant council)
15 Healthcare Services.safety: Taskora is not an emergency service. In an emergency call 1122 or go to the nearest hospital.

10 Tutors & Education.title: How tutoring works
steps: Book subject, tutor type and time
sla: Replacement tutor or refund if not satisfied
req: Subject expertise and 1+ year teaching experience
Background and police verification (access to minors)
10 Tutors & Education.safety: Sessions with children: a parent or guardian must be present or the session recorded (online). Tutors never write assignments for submission.

05 Legal Services.title: How legal services work
steps: Book a service, date and time
Taskora assigns the most suitable lawyer
Lawyer reviews and confirms the case
05 Legal Services.safety: Lawyers give advice; Taskora does not. No lawyer can guarantee a case outcome. Court fees, stamp duty and government charges are paid separately.

09 IT Services & Software.title: How IT projects work
steps: Taskora assigns an IT expert or team
09 IT Services & Software.safety: Source code and credentials belong to the client on final payment. Security testing only with the system owner's written permission.

13 HR & Recruitment.title: How HR services work
steps: Taskora assigns an HR expert or team
req: Qualified HR professionals (MBA HR / MS HR)
13 HR & Recruitment.safety: Candidates are never charged a fee for a job. Domestic-staff placements follow provincial domestic-worker laws, with written terms and no under-age workers.

18 Logistics & Transport.title: Moving, A to Z
req: Valid driving licence and vehicle registration
18 Logistics & Transport.safety: Rates vary by distance, volume, floor level and access. Insurance is optional and provided by a licensed insurer on declared value.

20 Insurance, Financial & Investment.title: Financial ecosystem (Phase 2 and 3)
sla: Every product is offered by a licensed, regulated institution
Taskora does not hold customer money or investments
Shariah-compliant options certified by the partner's Shariah board
req: SBP / SECP / PMEX licence as applicable
20 Insurance, Financial & Investment.safety: Not available yet. Investments carry risk and past returns do not guarantee future results. Taskora is not a bank, broker, insurer or investment adviser.

21 Taskora Market Store.title: How the Market Store works
steps: Delivered to your door or job site
req: Genuine products with batch and expiry where required
21 Taskora Market Store.safety: Prices shown only after distributors list them. Stamp papers and regulated items are sold only by licensed vendors.
